description: 08:00 - 09:30: Balanced cement plug m 2416 m mixed and pumped 9,4 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 2900 l of drill water. Zeroed volume counters. Displaced the cement with 37 m3 strokes) of SW, 2900 l/min/ 51 bar. Pulled out of cement to 2416m at 4 min/stand. Theoretical TOC 2416 m MD.
